subject: general
question: Rukmini Devi Arundale was associated with which classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale, the first woman in Indian history to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha. is associated with Bharatanatyam__.

 __
 
• Also an activist for animal rights and welfare.
 
• Rukmini Devi features in India Today's list of '100 People Who Shaped India'.
 
• Kalakshetra Foundation at Adyar, Chennai was established by Rukmini Devi.
 
• Rukmini Devi was nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha in April 1952 and re-nominated in 1956.
 
• Google also featured her in the 2017 Google Doodle for International Women's Day.
 
• Awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1956.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Sattriya
 
 __
 
• Classical dances of India originated in Assam.
 
• Recognized in 2000 as a classical dance by Sangeet Natak Akademi of India.
 
• Noted Sattriya exponents are: Indira PP Bora, Maniram Datta Muktiyar, Guru Jatin Goswami
 
 
 
 

 Kathak
 
 
 
• The term Kathak derived from the Sanskrit word 'Katha' meaning story.
 
• Kathak is unique in having both Hindu and Muslim cultural elements.
 
• Noted Kathak exponents are: Shambhu Maharaj, Lacchu Maharaj, Sitara Devi, and Pandit Birju Maharaj.
 
 
 
 

 Kuchipudi
 
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance of Andhra Pradesh__.
 
• Origin from the group of dancers going to the villages to perform known as Kusselavas.
 
• Kuchipudi derives its name from the village Kusselavapuri in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Vijayanagar and Golconda rulers patronized the dance form.
